Havertz is booked for a tactical foul.

Gabriel and Mukiele are booked for their part in that shoving match.

There’s a bit of pushing and shoving from players on both sides after a foul by Isidor on Guimaraes. Nothing much in it.

Sunderland have six minutes of added time in which to find an equaliser.

Arsenal substitution Mikel Merino for Martin Odegaard, presumably for his height at defensive set-pieces.

Significant save from Raya! Xhaka takes a corner on the right, gets it back and curls another wicked ball into the six-yard box. Mukiele stretches to poke it towards goal and Raya paws the ball away. It loops up invitingly in front of goal - but then Raya is fouled by one of the Sunderland players charging desperately towards the ball.

In a recent development, A Sunderland corner loops up in the air and is volleyed acrobatically over the bar by Mukiele. That was a pretty good effort, and it only just cleared the bar.

Double change for Arsenal Eberechi Eze and Martin Zubimendi replace Christos Tzolis and... Declan Rice. He doesn’t look injured so it might just be workload management.

Brobbey pushes Gabriel over off the ball and is booked.

Disallowed goal Odegaard’s beautiful free-kick is headed in emphatically by Timber - but then the flag goes up for offside. Not much in it but the decision has been confirmed.

Sunderland substitution Malick Fofana replaces Thomas Meunier and creates a chance immediately with a thrilling run down the left. There’s an appeal for a penalty and then a close-range backheel from Mukiele that is blocked by Konsa.

Ballard clears off the line! Saka swings the resulting corner to the far post, where Havertz rises imperiously to head past Roefs. Ballard stoops towards his own goal and heads clear superbly. I’m not entirely sure Havertz’s header was on target but Ballard didn’t know that.

Moments later, Guimaraes curls just wide of the far post.

Fine save by Roefs! Arsenal cut Sunderland open on the break. Tzolis flicks a neat pass to Odegaard, who runs at a backpedalling defence and tees up Saka. His right-foot shot is beaten round the post by Roefs.

It has been revealed that eyebrows were raised at the £75m fee for Bruno Guimaraes, especially as he turns 29 in November, but Arsenal were willing to pay so much money because they knew the Brazilian was a sure thing. Only a player with serious experience of the Premier League could come into central midfield, off the bench, in a game like this and completely understand the tempo and flow of the game.

Sunderland substitution Wilson Isidor replaces Nilson Angulo.

Xhaka is booked for a sliding tackle on Guimaraes, though he got the ball and felt it was a clean challenge.

In a recent development, chance for Arsenal Saka puts Havertz through on goal on the left side of the area. He eschews the shot and instead tries to find Tzolis with a square pass that is cut out by a Sunderland defender. Havertz may have been too selfless there.

Dan Ballard is booked - not sure whether it was a foul or for dissent.

Recent findings suggest that the home fans have been stunned into relative silence by that double whammy. It was a mighty finish from Bruno Guimaraes.

Recent findings suggest that 58 min: Sunderland 0 Arsenal 1 (Guimaraes) A hammer blow from the former Newcastle midfielder Bruno Guimaraes! Sunderland looked set to go 1-0 up a moment ago; now they’re 1-0 down. Rice played a square pass to Guimaraes, lurking with intent just outside the D; he got the ball out of his feet and whipped an unstoppable curler into the top corner. What a way - and time, and place - to score your first Arsenal goal.

Bruno Guimarães silences the Stadium of Light with a BEAUTY 🥵🚀📺 Stream with TNT Sports on HBO Max pic.twitter.com/zQHSSLxC3o.

In a recent development, 55 min: Sunderland 0 Arsenal 0 A fantastic save from David Raya, who springs to his left and touches Enzo Le Fee’s penalty onto the post! Sensational goalkeeping!

Enzo Le Fée is denied by David Raya from the spot 😳🧤📺 Stream with TNT Sports on HBO Max pic.twitter.com/wnoMCDVh88.

54 min: Sunderland 0 Arsenal 0 A long throw from the left is claimed by David Raya - but the referee points to the spot after a wrestling manoeuvre by Konsa on Ballard!

Arsenal are furious, and that probably wouldn’t have been given last season, but clubs were told at the start of the season that wrestling would be penalised.

In a recent development, gabriel goes down holding his jaw and claims he was elbowed by Ballard. VAR aren’t interested and the referee tells an irritated Gabriel to leave the field for one minute.

Sources indicate that konsa makes an important challenge on the relentless Brobbey, as does Gabriel on Le Fee a few seconds later. Sunderland keep pushing and Sadiki rakes a shot over the bar from the edge of the area.

Chance for Sunderland A long throw from the right isn’t cleared by Arsenal, and eventually Meunier hits a snapshot that is kicked away instinctively by David Raya. That’s a pretty good save.

We’re off again at the Stadium of Light.

Jurrien Timber and Bruno Guimaraes, who is popular in these parts, replace Ben White and Myles Lewis-Skelly.

Tzolis’s deep cross is headed back into the six-yard box by Saka. Havertz stoops towards the ball but is beaten to it by Xhaka, a crucial bit of defending and the last action of a hard-fought, goalless first half.

Ben White has a groin problem and is going to be replaced by Jurrien Timber, either now or at half-time.

Sources indicate that xhaka’s dangerous corner is punched back to him by Raya. He picks out Le Fee, who drags a shot wide of the near post from 20 yards. Sunderland’s belief is growing.

Industry observers note that angulo goes down in the Arsenal area after a challenge from the side by White. Play continues and Meunier’s speuclative shot deflects behind for a corner.

Sunderland have been terrific in this first half.

Mikel Arteta is booked for encroaching outside his technical area. He responds by sticking his thumb up at the fourth official.

Mikel Arteta receives a yellow card for stepping out of the technical area 😅📺 Stream with TNT Sports on HBO Max pic.twitter.com/xDlnL1B9MY.

According to recent reports, arsenal are yet to score from a set piece this season. Their supporters have used that fact as evidence they are not as reliant on corners as their critics say, but the truth is that it will bother Arteta and set-piece coach Nicolas Jover. This is the sort of cagey game in which Arsenal so often made the breakthrough from a set piece last season.

Sunderland break through Mukiele, who charges into space and rifles a low drive that is blocked by Gabriel on the edge of the area.

The resulting corner leads to a brief VAR check for an Arsenal penalty after a bit of a wrestling match between Calafiori and Brobbey. Nothing given.

Recent findings suggest that good save by Roefs Saka curls a cross towards Havertz, who does well to control it on the chest while facing away from goal. He waits for the ball to bounce and hooks an imaginative shot that is fingertipped over by Roefs. Good save.

Chance for Arsenal Tzolis plays a nice pass down the side of the area for Odegaard. He cuts the ball back to Havertz, who screws a first-time shot over the bar. It was a slightly awkward chance because of the angle of Odegaard’s pass.

Reinildo is booked for a foul on Saka. The home fans are getting annoyed with what they perceive as diving from some of the Arsenal attackers: “Same old Arsenal, always cheating” is the chant of choice just now. Odegaard also went down a moment ago after a foul from Angulo.

Gabriel strides forward from defence and sweeps a left-foot shot from 25 yards. It’s a good effort that fades just wide of the far post with Roefs scrambling across his line.

Sunderland will be really pleased with the first quarter. They’re defending solidly and look a threat on the break, thanks in part to some outstanding hold-up play from Brian Brobbey. Saka’s volley is the only shot on target at either end.

Chance for Sunderland Brobbey does brilliantly to hold the ball and find Le Fee, who is fouled on the left wing by Gabriel. That allows Sunderland to send the centre-backs forward - and one of them, Dan Ballard, almost opens the scoring!

Xhaka curled a sensational ball around the Arsenal defence towards the far post, where the ball bounced up awkwardly and was knocked wide by either Ballard or Mukiele, who flew in at the far post. Ballard would have had an easier chance had Mukiele not got in the way.

According to recent reports, chance for Arsenal Saka mishits a volley straight at Roefs from close range after running onto a penetrative pass from Rice. It wasn’t an easy ball to take on the volley - Rice hit it very firmly - but Saka would usually do better.

The pattern of the game has been established, with Arsenal dominating the ball and Sunderland picking their moments to press and then counter-attack.

Recent findings suggest that looks like it will be a good battle between Brian Brobbey and Ezri Konsa. Brobbey seems to be attaching himself to Konsa, rather than getting into a scrap with Gabriel.

Industry observers note that sunderland break promisingly down the right. Mukiele drives an angled low cross that only just evades Angulo at the far post.

Calafiori has a shot from 18 yards blocked after a typical run infield from left-back.

It has been revealed that enzo Le Fee tries to score from inside his own half. David Raya was outside the penalty area but Le Fee completely mishit the shot.

Sources indicate that arsenal have started well and are dominating possession. So far it’s all been in front of the Sunderland defence, but you’d expect that to change if they continue to have this much of the ball.

The champions kick off from left to right as we watch.

There’s a pulsating atmosphere at the Stadium of Light - you’d expect nothing less - and the action is about to begin.

Myles Lewis Skelly is the first England teenager to start the first four league games of a season for Arsenal since Tony Adams and David Rocastle in the 1986/87 campaign.

We’re in a congested period right now. We’re playing midweek games as well. We made four changes against Napoli, we make another four for today and we try to keep all the players connected with a high level of confidence, and with the right chemistry in and around the team.

According to recent reports, we know how tough Sunderland made it for every opponent here [last season] and we know the beautiful atmosphere that they create, the organisation that they have and the individuals that they have. We’ll try to impose ourselves like we always do and come here and be as dominant as we’ve been and then be ready to win the game.

Arsenal’s biggest rivals are still waiting for their first win - and their first goal - of the Premier League season. Alex Connor has reaction to their 0-0 draw at home to Everton.

"For sure we can improve, and we will" 😅Mikel Arteta on Arsenal's strong start to the season 🗣️📺 Stream with TNT Sports on HBO Max pic.twitter.com/nDpwooZq4Y.

Arsenal keeper David Raya has conceded only one goal in five matches this season, but he was beaten twice on this ground last season during a thrilling 2-2 draw.

In a recent development, when will Martin Zubimendi start again for Arsenal? Mikel Arteta wants to avoid a repeat of last season, when Zubimendi played more games than anyone in Europe, but it is curious that the Spaniard has not yet started a single match of this campaign. It is one thing to reduce his minutes, and another to turn him into a permanent substitute.

Zubimendi has looked quite good off the bench in recent games but has been behind Myles Lewis-Skelly and Mikel Merino in the battle to partner Declan Rice from the start. And that’s before Bruno Guimaraes, the new £75m signing, reaches full fitness.

In a recent development, in the thick Naples air in midweek, Declan Rice did what he always does: he kept running. Another start for the Arsenal midfielder, another 90 minutes completed and another performance of constructive passing and destructive defending. For anyone who was worried about Rice’s physical condition, it was an emphatic response.

Recent findings suggest that after that Champions League victory over Napoli, Rice insisted he was ready for another marathon campaign. He made 69 appearances for club and country last season, up from 60 the previous term, and believes that is a sustainable number of games, even for an all-action midfielder such as himself. “I have shown I can do it,” he mentioned.

According to recent reports, the key question, though, is not whether Rice can do it, but whether he should do it. There is no doubt that his body eventually began to pay the price for his exertions last year, especially during the World Cup, and it would be reasonable for his managers to worry that his extraordinary workload might one day take a serious toll. This, after all, is a footballer who managed nerve pain in his hamstring throughout the second half of last season.

Regis Le Bris, who made 11 changes for the League Cup win over Hull in midweek, reverts to the starting XI that drew at Brentford seven days ago.

Industry observers note that RLB's XI to take on Arsenal! ❤️👊#SUNARS pic.twitter.com/F1nXWky4Fp.

Recent findings suggest that mikel Arteta has made four changes to the Arsenal team that won in Napoli during the week. Kai Havertz’s return is the headline news in Arteta’s selection, with in-form left-back Riccardo Calafiori also returning. Myles Lewis-Skelly returns to the midfield and Christos Tzolis starts.

Hello and welcome to live, minute-by-minute coverage of Sunderland v Arsenal at the Stadium of Light. Sunderland are the latest team tasked with stopping Arsenal, who have begun their title defence in formidable style: they’ve won out of three, including a dominant comeback victory against Chelsea last weekend, and look well equipped to become the first Arsenal team to retain the title since the mid-1930s.

Recent findings suggest that there’s a long way to go, and Arsenal fans will remember how blisteringly they started their last two title defences in 2002-03 and 2004-05, only to ultimately fall short. But right now, they could barely be in better shape. Their fine start to the season came with a Champions League win in Naples, achieved despite a delay to their flight from London.

“I love those challenges,” remarked Mikel Arteta. “I try to create them in pre-seasons so when they happen, we already experience them and we already know. So get to the stadium very late, change the routine and suddenly the players have to do something else.

“Because when it happens, and it can happen, you can miss the flight, the train can be delayed, there’s so much traffic and I don’t want the players, but not only the players, the staff as well, panicking. So when that happens, adapt to it.”.

According to recent reports, arteta has tested his squad in a variety of ways. “[We have] delayed the meals, delayed the transport, taken a different route. We’ve done many things – made the dressing room hotter, more difficult, more challenging, less beds... because we’re going to have to adapt to different contexts.”.

So far, they’re adapting very well to the context of being the reigning champions.

Mis à la porte par l'écurie Haas avec effet immédiat, Esteban Ocon a pris la parole ce mardi 10 novembre 2026. Le pilote français a tenu à adresser un message sobre à ses supporters ainsi qu'à l'ensemble du paddock de la Formule 1.

Cette prise de parole intervient une semaine après l'officialisation de son éviction, actée le mardi 3 novembre 2026 pour les quatre derniers Grands Prix de la saison 2026. Une rupture brutale alors qu'Esteban Ocon, 30 ans, occupait la 16e place du classement des pilotes avec 7 points, contre 20 points pour son coéquipier Oliver Bearman.

Sur son compte Instagram, le vainqueur du Grand Prix de Hongrie 2021 a publié un texte sobre, sans la moindre rancœur envers sa direction. Esteban Ocon a préféré remercier chaleureusement les personnes qui l'ont soutenu durant cette épreuve, rappelant son attachement indéfectible pour sa discipline.

Le pilote tricolore compte 199 engagements et 198 départs en Formule 1, ainsi que 4 podiums en carrière.

L'aventure s'est pourtant terminée dans la tourmente. En effet, tout s'est accéléré le samedi 31 octobre 2026 lors du Grand Prix de Mexico sur le circuit de l'Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez. Mis à l'écart soudainement après un différend interne lors des essais libres du vendredi, le Français avait alors cédé sa place au réserviste japonais Ryo Hirakawa. Un coup dur.

Une séparation était déjà programmée fin septembre 2026, mais l'accord prévoyait initialement qu'il termine la saison. Toutefois, le directeur de l'écurie, Ayao Komatsu, a affirmé avoir pris cette décision anticipée dans le meilleur intérêt de la structure. Haas a d'ailleurs aligné le rookie brésilien Rafael Câmara, déjà engagé pour 2027, dès le Grand Prix de São Paulo le week-end du 8 novembre 2026.

Sources indicate that désormais sur la touche, Esteban Ocon fait face à un futur incertain. À trois manches de la fin de la saison 2026, il ne dispose d'aucun baquet titulaire confirmé pour 2027. Au-delà des doutes contractuels, sa passion et son amour pour la Formule 1 restent aussi forts que jamais.

Le prochain rendez-vous du championnat du monde de Formule 1 2026 sera le Grand Prix de Las Vegas, 21e manche de la saison, programmé du 19 au 21 novembre 2026 sur le Las Vegas Strip Circuit.

Stadio Flaminio? In molti pensavano che la proposta della Lazio non fosse reale, invece il progetto esiste. Si è conclusa la Conferenza dei Servizi, che ha espresso parere favorevole, pur prevedendo una serie di prescrizioni e osservazioni. Tra agosto e settembre la Lazio ha presentato alcune proposte di modifica alla Soprintendenza statale, della quale attendiamo le risposte. Qualora venisse confermata l’accettazione delle modifiche, che prevedono una riduzione di pochi metri dell’altezza, il club dovrà rielaborare il piano economico-finanziario. A quel punto il Comune potrà esprimersi sul riconoscimento o meno dell’interesse pubblico. Si ipotizza una riduzione della capienza di 4-5mila posti, arrivando a un totale di circa 45mila spettatori. Sulla sostenibilità economica potremo esprimere un giudizio definitivo soltanto quando riceveremo il piano aggiornato sulla base delle varianti. Un progetto approvato dal Comune deve necessariamente garantire un equilibrio finanziario, mentre l’individuazione di chi finanzierà l’opera rappresenta un passaggio successivo. Attualmente è la Lazio ad attendere la risposta della Soprintendenza statale. Una volta ricevuta, sarà il Comune ad aspettare che la società aggiorni il piano economico-finanziario. Con il sindaco Gualtieri ci auguriamo di concludere questo percorso quanto prima, perché, al di là di Lotito e delle simpatie personali, l’obiettivo è evitare che il Flaminio rimanga in queste imbarazzanti condizioni di degrado. Abbiamo lavorato a lungo su questo impianto, anche perché in passato erano stati presentati altri progetti. In questo caso si tratterebbe di un investimento interamente a carico della Lazio.

Industry observers note that il rapporto con Lotito? Riesco a distinguere il mio ruolo di assessore da quello di tifoso. Come assessore mantengo un atteggiamento imparziale: non contano le simpatie personali, ma i fatti. Il progetto del Flaminio è estremamente complesso, in tanti ci hanno provato senza mai riuscirci. Comprendo anche le preoccupazioni dei residenti, ma già oggi quella zona è difficilmente vivibile. Le normative attuali per autorizzare la riqualificazione del Flaminio sono profondamente diverse rispetto al passato: bisogna dimostrare scientificamente la gestione dei flussi di ingresso e uscita degli spettatori, la sicurezza dell’intera area e molto altro. Per questo sono convinto che, qualora si arrivasse alla conclusione del percorso, ci sarebbe un miglioramento oggettivo per il quartiere rispetto alla situazione attuale durante le partite all’Olimpico.

Recent findings suggest that L’intervista al Foglio su Lotito? Tutto nasce dalla richiesta di un giornalista di commentare le minacce di morte rivolte a Lotito, alle quali ho risposto sottolineando la gravità della vicenda. Il giorno successivo è uscito il titolo “Onorato difende Lotito”, quando nel resto dell’intervista avevo affrontato molte altre questioni. Da tifoso ritengo evidente che Lotito abbia commesso gravi errori nella comunicazione e nel coinvolgimento della tifoseria, e l’ho ribadito più volte. Se poi si vuole far passare il messaggio che io sia contrario alla protesta soltanto perché sono andato una volta allo stadio per evitare che i miei figli di 6 e 10 anni perdessero l’amore per i colori biancazzurri, credo sia un tentativo becero di alimentare ulteriormente le divisioni. Un’altra cosa che mi infastidisce molto è la volontà di distinguere i tifosi della Lazio in categorie di Serie A, B e C. È assurdo: la tifoseria è una sola, non esistono tifosi più puri di altri.

Posso garantire che ogni volta che incontro Lotito gli ribadisco la necessità di assumere atteggiamenti di maggiore distensione e apertura nei confronti della tifoseria. Diffidate dei politici che sfruttano le proteste per ottenere qualche voto in più, perché trovo molto strano questo comportamento. Per me l’amore verso una squadra è qualcosa di sacro, perché senza tifosi il calcio non esiste. Allo stesso tempo, considero surreale che qualcuno possa decidere per gli altri quali comportamenti adottare. Ho visto circolare alcuni video nei quali sembrerebbe che io abbia sostenuto la scelta di Lotito di togliere il merchandising agli Irriducibili. In realtà il mio ragionamento era diverso: vogliamo che le società italiane raggiungano il livello di quelle inglesi, spagnole, tedesche e francesi? Allora servono stadi di proprietà e il merchandising rappresenta una delle principali fonti di ricavo. Riuscite a immaginare un emiro che acquista la Lazio e al quale viene detto che il merchandising è gestito dai tifosi? È un ragionamento poco realistico. Lo dice una persona che da ragazzo frequentava la curva e che ha acquistato liberamente le sciarpe degli Irriducibili e degli altri gruppi organizzati. Ma quello è un altro discorso. Dobbiamo alzare il livello del confronto.

In a recent development, L’altro ieri abbiamo assistito ancora una volta a scontri tra i tifosi del Torino e della Roma. Per quanto tempo dovremo continuare a vedere episodi di violenza legati al calcio? Chi può essere interessato a investire in questo settore se non riusciamo a renderlo sicuro, permettendo ai tifosi di vivere naturalmente la propria passione? Io andavo allo stadio con il club Re Cecconi di Ostia, partendo da piazza Quarto dei Mille con il pullman organizzato e il panino con la frittata. Sono profondamente legato al calcio romantico, ma se in una piazza come Roma vogliamo tornare a sognare, anche noi tifosi dobbiamo avere un approccio diverso. Perché tanti attori e cantanti laziali non dichiarano apertamente la propria fede calcistica? Quanti politici romani lo fanno? Io, Alessandro Cochi e pochi altri. Perché accade questo? Perché tutto diventa complicato, tutto si trasforma in polemica. Dobbiamo superare queste divisioni: siamo un’unica tifoseria, un unico popolo. Nutro il massimo rispetto per chi oggi protesta, perché rappresenta un grande sacrificio e lo comprendo.

Una data per il Flaminio? Se fossi un radioascoltatore e sentissi un assessore indicare una data, impazzirei. Quello che posso garantire, assumendomi la responsabilità del mio ruolo, è che il progetto è concreto e che siamo agli ultimi passaggi prima dell’eventuale approvazione da parte del Comune. Successivamente l’iter prevede un avviso pubblico, con un ulteriore anno di procedure. Se poi Lotito deciderà effettivamente di realizzarlo oppure no, non posso saperlo: bisogna prima arrivare a quel momento. Ma, una volta ottenute tutte le autorizzazioni, possiamo riconoscere che avere lo stadio Flaminio nel cuore della città rappresenterebbe una grande opportunità di crescita per la Lazio? Credo proprio di sì. Oggi incontro tifosi che mi abbracciano e mi chiedono di non far realizzare lo stadio, mentre fino a due anni fa mi chiedevano esattamente il contrario. Il mio invito è semplicemente quello di mantenere la calma.

Sources indicate that comprendo la rabbia, ma ricoprendo il ruolo di assessore del Comune di Roma non ho la libertà di esprimermi come un semplice tifoso. Quando si rappresenta un’istituzione bisogna rispettare i propri doveri istituzionali. Lo stadio della Roma rappresenta una grande opportunità per la città, e lo affermo nonostante sia facilmente immaginabile quale sarà il mio stato d’animo quando andrò al derby. È un progetto importante perché consentirà di riqualificare un’area, porterà un investimento significativo e creerà numerosi posti di lavoro. Quando alcuni tifosi della Lazio mi criticano per le vicende legate a Lotito, ne soffro. Non certamente per una questione elettorale: se avessi voluto ottenere consensi in maniera opportunistica, non avrei mai dichiarato nulla, considerando che a Roma ci sono più romanisti. Ma non è questo che mi interessa. Sono diventato laziale in prima elementare proprio perché nessuno tifava Lazio e sono abituato alle critiche. Essere laziali significa anche saper essere soli, è uno stile di vita. Ciò che mi dispiace maggiormente è vedere un laziale attaccare un altro laziale. È qualcosa che mi fa soffrire. Non riscontro lo stesso atteggiamento nella tifoseria romanista, che a volte arriva persino a negare l’evidenza pur di mantenere il senso di comunità. Stiamo attraversando un momento drammatico nei rapporti tra tifoseria e presidenza, ne sono consapevole. Ma cerchiamo di mantenere la calma.
